hub.name: Clip

title: !clip command
subtitle: Create clips of the live stream from chat
loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded.
forbidden: You don't have permission to configure this command.
leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

general.commandHint: Type {{command}} in chat during the stream to create a clip. It only works on Twitch.
general.languageHint: The language the bot uses to answer in chat.
general.aliasesHint: Separated by commas and without «!». Example: clipit, makeclip
general.durationHint: Duration in seconds. Twitch accepts clips from 5 to 60 seconds.
general.allowViewerDurationHint: With {{example}} the viewer asks for 20 seconds. Moderators and above can always do it.
general.allowTitleHint: With {{example}} the clip gets that title. Twitch checks it with AutoMod.
general.otherPlatformsHint: Kick doesn't let a bot create clips. Choose what the command does there.
general.downloadEnabledHint: By default only the link is saved. If you turn this on, every clip created is downloaded to the platform archive. If the server is low on space, downloads pause by themselves and only the link keeps being saved.
general.downloadCap: The administrator set a limit of {{cap}} downloads per month for your channel.
general.retentionHint: After this time the rows are deleted automatically. Downloaded videos are not deleted.

permissions.minRoleHint: Minimum rank. Higher ranks can always use it.
permissions.followerNote: For «Followers» the bot asks Twitch on every use; subscribers, VIPs and moderators pass without a check.
permissions.blocksHint: They can't use !clip in your channel, whatever their rank.
permissions.blockFailed: That user could not be blocked.

cooldowns.title: Cooldowns
cooldowns.globalHint: Minimum time between one clip and the next, from anyone.
cooldowns.userHint: Time each person waits before creating another clip.
cooldowns.staffSkip: Moderators and above skip the per-user cooldown
cooldowns.limitValue: Maximum clips per user in each stream

messages.title: Chat messages

keys.clipsRestricted: Clips for followers or subs only
keys.noScope: Account needs to be linked again

guide.title: How it works
guide.intro: `!clip` creates a clip of the live stream from chat and posts the link. Follow these steps to get it running.
guide.step1: Turn on «Command enabled» above and save.
guide.step2: In Permissions choose who can use it and, if you want, block users.
guide.step3: With your channel live, type !clip in chat.
guide.step4: Check the result in History: who asked, the link and whether it failed.
guide.tabGeneral: Language, aliases, duration, title, Kick, video download and history.
guide.tabMessages: The texts the bot writes, in Spanish and English.
guide.limitLive: Clips can only be created while the channel is live, and only on Twitch.
guide.limitMusic: If the stream has copyrighted music, Twitch doesn't publish the clip: the bot waits and says it wasn't ready. With royalty-free music it works.
guide.limitScope: If the bot says the clips permission is missing, link your Decatron account again.
